walkthroughs.title: Get started with Mochi
walkthroughs.description: Install the binary, start a session, and send your first selection to the agent.

steps.title: Install the Mochi binary
steps.description:
The sidebar talks to `mochi acp` over stdio.
[Check Health](command:mochi.checkHealth)

media.markdown:
Install the agent binary:

```sh
npm i -g @mochi/agent
```

Then verify it answers:

1. Run **Mochi: Check Agent Health** from the Command Palette.
2. If the binary is not on your `PATH`, set `mochi.binaryPath` to its absolute path (a path ending in `.js` runs under Node).

steps.title: Start a new session
steps.description:
Open a folder, then start chatting.
[New Session](command:mochi.newSession)

media.markdown:
1. Open a workspace folder (Mochi spawns `mochi acp` in the workspace root).
2. Run **Mochi: New Session** or press the *New session* button in the Mochi sidebar.
3. Watch the status bar: `Mochi <version> · <session> · act` means you are connected.

steps.title: Send a selection to the agent
steps.description:
Select code, then ask for a change.
[Send Selection to Agent](command:mochi.promptSelection)

media.markdown:
1. Select code in any editor.
2. Right-click and pick **Mochi: Send Selection to Agent**, or press `Ctrl+Alt+M` (`Cmd+Alt+M` on macOS).
3. Describe the change (explain, refactor, add tests) — the selection is attached automatically with its file and line number.

mochi.binaryPath.description: Path to the Mochi binary used to spawn `mochi acp`. Use an absolute path when mochi is not on your PATH. A path ending in .js is executed with Node.

mochi.workspaceTrust.description: Refuse to spawn the agent when the current workspace is not trusted.

mochi.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for a single session/prompt round-trip (ms). Streaming chunks keep the session alive; this only fires when the server goes silent.

mochi.maxSessionHistory.description: How many chat messages the sidebar keeps before trimming oldest first.

mochi.showNotifications.description: Show VS Code notifications for session lifecycle (new session, errors, ACP restarts).
